user.title: Elysium
user.description: Open Elysium on your phone, go to the central unit and tap Pair Home Assistant. Type the code it shows below.

error.invalid_code: That code is not valid any more. Codes last ten minutes and work once — ask the app for a new one.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Elysium. Check that this Home Assistant has internet access, then try again.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Elysium is already set up on this Home Assistant.

init.title: Elysium
init.description: Leave the code empty to keep the current pairing. Poll interval 0 uses adaptive server control: frequent checks while a timed reward is open, infrequent checks while idle. This interval detects failed recovery; it does not determine the normal relock time, which Home Assistant owns locally.

data.poll_interval_seconds: Poll interval override in seconds (0 = adaptive)
